prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively rooftop party at night. On the far left stands a woman in a blue dress holding a champagne flute, her posture upright and elegant. Next to her is a man in a yellow shirt who is looking at the woman in the blue dress. A small white cat sits on the railing beside the man in the yellow shirt, gazing outward. In the center foreground, a brown dog lies on the concrete floor, resting its head on its paws. Behind the dog, a couple dances; the man wears a green suit and the woman wears a pink skirt, their hands clasped together as they move. To the right of the dancing couple, a waiter in a black vest is handing a tray of appetizers to a guest in a purple jacket. The guest in the purple jacket reaches out to take a canape from the tray. Near the right edge, a musician in a striped shirt plays a silver saxophone, his cheeks puffed with effort. A large speaker sits next to the musician, vibrating slightly. Above them, string lights stretch across the sky, glowing with warm yellow bulbs. A potted palm tree stands near the speaker, its fronds stylized and sharp. A girl in a red hat points at the moon, which hangs high in the dark blue sky. Beside her, a boy in a denim jacket looks at the girl in the red hat with interest. A stack of empty glasses rests on a nearby table, reflecting the ambient light. An older woman in a grey shawl sits on a wooden bench, watching the scene with a calm expression. A young man in an orange beanie leans against the wall near the bench, checking his phone. A balloon floats near the ceiling of the frame, tethered by a thin string. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no furniture other than the single wooden bench. There is no text or signage visible anywhere in the scene.
